7884.title: Runner teardown already removes temporary storage
7884.rootCauseOneLine: The helper eagerly allocates storage and relies on dispose(), but main already sandboxes worker TMPDIR and removes the entire tree in runner-level teardown.

prReviews.topFinding: Current main already has runner-owned cleanup; linked PR code was not executed.

7884.proposedFix: No new fix for ordinary repository runs; existing sandbox teardown removes the complete worker temporary tree.
7884.caveats: Linux current-main checks only; no macOS or historical execution. Standalone consumers and abnormal parent termination were not tested. The complete reproduction probe is inline in the HTML.
